_doc: Parameters of the anvil_gauntlets chassis weapon (tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_weapon.py + s2_gauntlet.py), v2 (2026-09-25 polish pass): built on the s202 blockout's own gauntlet field around the axis (axis_y, axis_z). Metres, Blender axes, Brax's T-pose (Z up, faces -Y, +X = his left; the left gauntlet is given, the right one is built on the right arm's own field). Each object is then re-expressed in its hand's weapon socket frame (origin palm centre, +Y along the fingers, +Z out of the back of the hand).

blockout_field._doc: blockout radius E(theta, x) sampled around the axis; median window (theta, x cells) removes the bolts; base_sigma = the smooth base B; lump_sigma smooths E - B before the plate-centre search; bake_x_min = where the bake source starts

radial_scale._doc: the blockout gauntlet's radius is scaled by S(|x|) about the axis (the concept's fists read bigger than the blockout's)

forearm_plates._doc: plate centres = maxima of the blockout's lumps (seed_spacing apart); tops follow the scaled blockout surface; gap = the glowing seam
forearm_plates._doc_seeds: blockout plate centres are taken in seed_x only: past 0.845 the blockout has a rivet row, replaced by one synthetic plate ring

hand._doc: hand core: superellipse sections [x, half-width y, half-height z, centre z offset]; it runs to 1.19 m so the wearer's fingers (tips at 1.18 m) end inside it and the rock fingers carry on from its front edge

strap_frame._doc: angular (hexagonal) bronze strap frame along the back of the forearm ending in a ring on the back of the wrist (approved turnaround sheet)

knuckle._doc: massive knuckle chunks on the top front edge of the hand, one per finger

fist._doc: closed-fist variant: the same segments curled under the palm, thumb across the front of the fingers

gauntlet._doc_build_offset: the blockout's gauntlet axis (axis_y, axis_z) sits 3 cm behind Brax's fitted forearm; the build moves the whole blockout field by build_offset onto the forearm
